title: Chapter 395
text:
No matter how popular Ames was, she would not be able to shake Han Xiao's position. After all, she was just a new character, and everyone was familiar with Han Xiao. His image would not be affected because of this. The Dragon Emperor was beautiful, but Han Xiao would be able to give her benefits.

What's the use of just looking good? Only a qualified NPC that can help us earn money is one that's above the low-level interests!

Furthermore, according to the progress of the third episode of Pork Bun's Black Star chapter, Han Xiao and the Dragon Emperor were on the same side. Their combined influence made the players look forward to it even more. Because Pork Bun had edited the Black Star series in the style of a series, Han Xiao and the Black Star Mercenary were the first-person perspective, which made the audience feel as if they were a member of the Black Star. Seeing the growth of the faction, they felt happy and empathized with it.

This episode was the new episode of the Black Phantom series. It was the end of the Germinal Organization. Han Xiao stole information from the Germinal Organization headquarters, ran for thousands of miles, fought countless fierce battles, and received reinforcements from the Six Nations, and fought his last battle in the encirclement. The convoy rushed across the vast yellow desert. The wind blew up sand and sand, and the air was filled with killing intent. The cannon fire was like a steel rainstorm, blowing up desert flowers, and the rumbling of the explosions was like rolling thunder that swept across the land.

The scene followed Pork Bun's perspective, and he personally participated in the battle in the dungeon. In order to better reflect the impact, he chose to be on the Germinal Organization's side. He personally saw Han Xiao rampaging around, unstoppable. His movements were like lightning. One moment, he killed a few Germinal Organization executives. The next moment, he flashed a few hundred meters away and knocked over a few off-road vehicles. The shockwaves were like knives, scratching their faces painfully.

In Pork Bun's scene, Han Xiao was like a boss, and the Germinal Organization leader was fighting him head-on. The shockwaves from the collisions were no less loud than the explosions of cannons. Even the air was shaking, and the scene was shaking. The shockwaves almost overflowed the scene. It was as if the scene would shatter like a mirror in the next moment.

As the two of them fought, they were like a dragon slithering through the entire battlefield. Just the aftershocks alone were enough to send the soldiers and chariots flying. The audience was so nervous that they did not even dare to breathe loudly.

Boom!

The last thunderous strike shook the scene.

The audience was shocked. Their emotions seemed to have drained a thousand miles away. They finally took a deep breath.

The Germinal Organization leader spat out blood and flew backward. He rolled on the sand, leaving a trail of more than a hundred meters. He fell to the ground and continued to vomit blood. On the other side, Han Xiao stood among the broken pieces of the mechanical suit on the ground. Pork Bun was knocked to the ground by the shockwave just now. Now, his perspective was looking up. The flying dust and sand fell like a yellow curtain being pulled apart. Han Xiao stood under the scorching sun, on the yellow sand, in the middle of the cannon fire, with lightning crackling all over his body.

At this moment, the level of coolness was maxed out.

Even if the Blue Star players knew that Han Xiao was very strong, they could not help but feel excited. It was the first time that the players from other planets saw Han Xiao's performance. It was the best performance of his career right off the bat. They were shocked. They could not help but tremble in excitement.

"Wow, this man is so strong."

"So he's this kind of person. He even had such an experience in the past."

Every novice planet had a main character. In comparison, Han Xiao was the most eye-catching existence. Many new viewers who were attracted by the Black Star chapter were surprised and interested. They wanted to look for Pork Bun's past videos to learn more about Han Xiao.

The video continued. The last scene was the nuclear explosion of the Germinal Organization headquarters.

The mushroom cloud rose into the sky, its shape unpredictable. The dark red flames in the thick smoke looked like boiling magma from hell.

It was earth-shattering.

Just as the audience was shocked, the sound of the explosion suddenly disappeared. Only the image of the nuclear explosion was left. At the same time, a man's voice sounded in the background.

"The dark clouds of war cover the blue sky like the wings of death."

At the end of the video, Pork Bun ingeniously added Han Xiao's speech.

The image here was the end of the Germinal Organization. The Six Nations dropped a nuclear bomb to end the war. The background was Han Xiao's speech when he built the sanctuary. The image of the nuclear explosion served as a foil to the content of the speech. The Six Nations started the war for their own interests, and the sanctuary aimed to preserve the fire of civilization. The contrast was very strong, and the feeling was different.

After the video ended, the audience was not satisfied. It was as if they had watched a short epic. Thinking back to the direction of the Blue Star story, they were filled with emotions.

Although Han Xiao did not say anything from the beginning to the end, with the speech that Pork Bun added at the end, his acting was off the charts.

Some of the audience imagined what he was thinking and interpreted his actions. At the time of the incident, there were already players who did similar things. Now, the topic was hot again.

"Real men don't talk nonsense. They just do it."

"Hehe, Zero is righteous and understands the suffering of the people. That's why he wants to destroy the evil Germinal Organization. Not bad, not bad. As expected of my husband."

"The input method of the commenter above is very smart."

"Black Phantom: Bullsh * t, I just want to elope with my sister. Do you think my nickname of 'Master Han' is just for show?"

Players from all walks of life discussed with their imaginations.

Although this video was rushed, Pork Bun was the production manager, so it attracted a lot of attention. Han Xiao's presence was greatly emphasized, and his influence was subtle. Han Xiao originally gave the players a rich impression, but this video of the end of the Germinal Organization made the players' impression of him sublimate and become clearer. He had a legendary aura, and his unique charm was slowly taking shape. It was the characteristic and personality that separated him from other characters. He was unique.

This was the goal that Han Xiao brought Pork Bun with him. Now, it seemed that he had done a good job. Han Xiao, who was building machinery, took a break to watch the video. He was very satisfied.

A few days later, in the machinery modification room …

The smell of metal filled the air. The results of the past few days, hundreds of small balls, were neatly stacked on the table.

"It's finally done. It's faster than I expected."

These creations were new machines that he had created by refining low-level machinery blueprints of the same type. Their performance and attributes were significantly improved, and they had many advantages. Before he started building, he had spent two to three million experience to level up these blueprints to the maximum level. The more he built, the more familiar he was with them, and the faster he could build them.

Han Xiao took off his protective suit, counted the number, and separated the different types of mechanical balls.

There was a method to using the compressed balls. Normally, Mechanics would carry these balls with them in a small bag or make them into accessories such as necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and so on. They could also be tied to the ends of their braids like Godora's Investigator, or put these balls into their combat suits.

Because the compressed structure was very tight, it was a whole, and there could not be any extra parts. Therefore, it was impossible to make a ball within a ball. Otherwise, it would be an infinite expansion. Only a whole machine or a single part could form a compressed ball.

Han Xiao had compressed the mechanical suit. Therefore, in his normal state, he used a black combat belt to store the compressed balls. This belt was originally used to store magazines. With the metal buckle as the center, the belt was split into two, forming an 'X' shape. It was clipped to his waist to increase his carrying capacity. This belt was used to store the more important weapons, and the core machinery like the mechanical suit was made into an accessory.

He wore a necklace made of three compressed balls, a bracelet on his left and right wrist, and two earrings made of small balls. He wore them on his left and right ears. His hair was not short, and it was tied into a braid. At the end of the braid, there were a few compressed balls tied to it.

Han Xiao came to the mirror and looked at himself. He was instantly overjoyed.
